title: Preservation in Perspective

creators.name: Koordinierungsstelle für die Erhaltung des schriftlichen Kulturguts

bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: The ‘Preservation in Perspective’ conference, held in 2021 to mark the 10th anniversary of the Coordination Office for the Preservation of Written Cultural Heritage (KEK), provided an opportunity to discuss the present and future of original preservation. Among the topics discussed were current developments in preservation, synergies with digitization projects, and opportunities for cross-border cooperation in the protection of cultural property.
